body:
Baseball fonts have become one of the most popular sports-themed typefaces that are widely used by designers, especially if they have baseball fans as their target audience.

Whether you’re trying to design a logo for a new baseball team or working on designing baseball-related clothing, this article is for you.

What is a good baseball font for designers?

Actually, there are a lot of fonts that can be considered the best baseball fonts for logo designers and creatives in general.

However, if you’re going to ask my personal preferences as a designer, I will recommend the Boston font.

It is the best baseball jersey font that can be used for a variety of design purposes, such as logos, shirts, caps, posters, etc.

You can also use the Bandbox if you’re interested in having the best baseball script font for designers.

On the other hand, if you’re a business owner that wants the perfect baseball typeface for producing baseball souvenirs, then the Pitcher is a must-have font.

For your design and branding purposes, I also included other ideal fonts for you to have a wide range of choices to choose from.

So without further ado, here’s my ultimate list of 10 best baseball fonts in 2023.

10 Best Baseball Fonts for Designers

  1. Boston
  2. Bandbox
  3. Swingman
  4. Flanders
  5. Jawbreak
  6. Pitcher
  7. Haglos
  8. Buinton
  9. Herchey Script
  10. Milestone Script

You can also check out my other article where you can learn how to choose fonts for logo design.

1. Boston

If you’re looking for a great baseball font to use for designing jerseys for a baseball team, then Boston is for you.

Boston is the best baseball font for jerseys.

This typeface is very modern and has uppercase and lowercase letters, numerals, and a lot of different punctuation.

It also has alternate characters, a stylistic set, an extruded font, and ligatures that will be perfect for designing jerseys.

As you can notice, the Boston baseball font also has a thick shadow, which makes it more appealing to the eyes.‍

Additionally, it is designed to have elegant strokes and can be used for a variety of design purposes, such as logos and brandmarks.

‍Download Boston Font Now

2. Bandbox

The next font on my list is the Bandbox, which is a baseball typeface that is inspired by classic logo lock-ups.

Bandbox is the best bold baseball script font.

What makes it different from other fonts is its heavy, streaming cursive letterforms that are ideal for any design related to sports.

‍In addition to the 18 athletic swash banners and ligatures that come with Bandbox, there are also a lot of other things that come with the font:

This is also one of the best athletic fonts to use for logos, posters, and t-shirt designs.

So if you’re looking for a baseball script font that you can use as a graphic and logo designer, then the Bandbox is a great choice to consider.

‍Download Bandbox Font Now

3. Swingman

If you’re a creative that is looking for a perfect vintage script font that you can use for creating a variety of designs, then check out the Swingman typeface.

Swingman is the best vintage baseball font.

It comes with 120 glyphs, including uppercase, lowercase, numbers, punctuation, ligatures, and a lot of alternate characters.

This font is designed to have an extended ending ligature, which makes it more iconic and attractive.‍

In fact, Swingman is one of the most popular baseball fonts for shirts, caps, and other clothing related to the sport of baseball.

So if you want to use the best vintage baseball font for your clothing and logo design, look no further, because Swingman is a great choice.

‍Download Swingman Font Now

4. Flanders

Another must-have typeface for design and branding is Flanders, a bold and modern script baseball font.

Flanders is the best modern script baseball font.

This font is perfect for designing a sporty theme, logo type, quotes, wordmarks, etc.

‍Flanders includes many OpenType features like ligature, stylistic alternate, contextual alternate, swash, etc. and supports multi-language support.

It is a complementary font that allows you to create an extrude or shadow effect in a snap without needing any graphic software tool.

Additionally, Flanders can also be used for product labels, captions, logo design, and more.

‍Download Flanders Font Now

5. Jawbreak

The next font on my list, named Jawbreak, is also an ideal baseball typeface that has three distinct styles and alternate cuts.

Jawbreak is a modern baseball font with classic edges.

It is one of the most versatile fonts that you can have as a logo designer and creative in general.

It is perfect for logotypes, sports branding, posters, apparel design, magazine headlines, labels, and so much more.

‍Jawbreak features a full Adobe Latin 1 character set, with support for most western languages, which makes it a flexible font.

This font is also designed to have all capital letters, which makes it appear more powerful and ideal for designing baseball team names.

‍Download Jawbreak Font Now

6. Pitcher

If you’re working for a baseball team or for clients that want to have a sports-themed logo, then the Pitcher is a great choice.

Pitcher is the best baseball font for sports team apparel.

It is a bold brush font ideal for sports team or bar logos, beer labels, or anything where you need a strong, sturdy script with lots of character.

This baseball typeface includes several OpenType features, including standard ligatures and contextual alternates for smooth connections between letters.

You can try swash or titling alternates when you need more customised headlines or when designing a logo, and look for Glyph Palette for even more alternates.

‍Pitcher’s unique and distinct extended ligatures make it an ideal font to use as a graphic and logo designer.

‍Download Pitcher Font Now

7. Haglos

For those who are looking for an ideal baseball font that has a retro vibe, then the Haglos is the best option for you.

Haglos is the best retro baseball font for designers.

This is a bold script typeface that has 3 styles, including regular, semi-bold, and bold, with an extrude effect for each style.

It is the perfect font choice if you want to have a font that is inspired by modern vintage and retro styles.‍

Additionally, Haglos are also a combination of old American traditional styles ideal for design and branding purposes.‍

Overall, Haglos is a great choice for designing logos, handwritten quotes, product packaging, headers, posters, merchandise, social media, and greeting cards.

‍Download Haglos Font Now

8. Buinton

Another must-have font for all creatives, especially logo designers, is this Buinton baseball typeface.

Buinton is a script baseball font with noble looks.

It has serifs at the beginnings of the strokes, swash capitals, and a formal design, and it has lots of alternate characters, swashes, and ligatures.

‍Buinton also has a bunch of tails with different shapes and widths to give a vintage logotype or sports look to your design.

In fact, this baseball font is considered one of the most versatile fonts, allowing you to design beautiful, elegant, and diverse typographic elements with it.

Moreover, it is a well-suited font for use in logos, lettering artwork, t-shirt designs, and editorial illustrations.

‍Download Buinton Font Now

9. Herchey Script

As a designer myself, I also want to introduce to you a new script baseball font called Herchey Script.

Hershey is the best baseball font for sport-related logos.

It is a high-quality script font with swashes inspired by modern vintage design and the baseball logo.

It has OpenType features with stylistic alternates, swashes, ligatures, stylistic set, terminal form, and ornament.

By using this baseball typeface, it will allow you to mix and match pairs of letters to fit your design.

Overall, the Herchey Script font is best for vintage design, t-shirts, logos, labels, badges, posters, etc.

‍Download Herchey Script Font Now

10. Milestone Script

And the last, and definitely not the least, baseball typeface on my list is a vintage baseball sport-inspired font named Milestone Script.

Milestone is the best baseball font that has classic vibes.

It is ideal for use for sign painting, labeling, old-fashioned coffee shops, bars, and everything with specific characteristics of past times.

This typeface is also well-suited for logo design and product naming packages.

It comes loaded with uppercase and lowercase characters, numerals, ligatures, and multilingual support.

Additionally, Milestone Script is a great font to use for combining classic and vintage feels to create a sophisticated yet appealing logo.

‍Download Milestone Script Font Now

Conclusions

A designer or person who helps people with their branding and design needs to think very carefully about which font to use for their logo.‍

That’s why if you’re working with a new baseball team or for an entrepreneur that wants to sell baseball souvenirs, using a baseball font is a great choice to consider.

What is a good font for baseball?

If you’re looking specifically for the best baseball fonts to use for your logo design and product labels, I’ve included some of the ideal options for you.

For instance, Jawbreak is a wise choice if you want to design your logo with all capital baseball-themed characters.

On the other hand, Haglos is the best choice for creatives that are looking for a great retro baseball font to use.

All the baseball typefaces on my list are all suitable for a variety of design and branding purposes, so the choice will only vary on your preference as a designer.
